errors.evidence: The plot contains six distinct lines, not five. The description itself contradicts this statement by listing all six lines immediately after.
The "Vanilla" model (purple line) is the lowest on the plot and stabilizes at a loss value closer to 2.45, not 2.5.
The "StrmLLM (n=64)" (blue) line stabilizes at a value closer to 2.62, not 2.65. While a minor difference, it is an overestimation.

errors.text_span: The "SepLLM (n=64)" (orange) and "SepLLM (n=64, H)" (green) lines are nearly identical
errors.evidence: The orange and green lines are clearly separate for most of the plot's duration, with the green line consistently having a lower loss value than the orange line. They are not nearly identical.

errors.text_span: both converging to a loss of approximately 2.55
errors.evidence: The green line converges to approximately 2.5 and the orange line converges to approximately 2.52. The value 2.55 is an inaccurate overestimation for both.

errors.text_span: The "SepLLM (n=64, H/T)" (red) line is slightly above the orange and green lines
errors.evidence: The red line is visibly below both the orange and green lines, indicating a lower loss. It is the second-lowest line on the entire plot.
The red line ("SepLLM (n=64, H/T)") stabilizes at a much lower loss value of approximately 2.48, not 2.57. The reported value is off by nearly a full tick mark interval (0.1).

errors.text_span: The "SepLLM (n=128)" (dark blue) line is the highest among the SepLLM variants
errors.evidence: Among the SepLLM variants (orange, green, red, dark blue), the orange line ("SepLLM (n=64)") ends at a higher loss value (approx. 2.52) than the dark blue line (approx. 2.51).
The dark blue line ("SepLLM (n=128)") stabilizes at a loss value of approximately 2.51, not 2.6. The reported value is off by almost a full tick mark interval (0.1).
